ITEM 1 | Half of a round, ring-shaped bread roll (bagel-like) with a golden-tan crust edge and pale cream interior, topped with a thick, smooth, opaque white spread covering most of the cut face, with a small hole in the center; sits at the left of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 3 cm tall, touching the scrambled eggs and strawberries | 85
ITEM 2 | Scrambled eggs: pale yellow to light golden clumps with soft, slightly glossy curds and small irregular folds, no visible browning, moist-looking but holding shape in mounds; sits in the upper right of the plate, spanning roughly 11 x 8 cm and about 2 cm high | 110
ITEM 3 | Fresh strawberries, cut into wedges and halves: bright red flesh with white core areas and slightly seedy surface, glossy and juicy-looking, firm; five to six pieces arranged along the lower right edge of the plate, each wedge about 4 x 3 cm and 2 to 2.5 cm thick | 115
